item.title: ESA deal with Isar Aerospace covers 6 missions, sources claim
item.description: ESA's Launcher Challenge award to Isar Aerospace covers 6 missions, not the announced number, people familiar with the deal claim.
item.content:encoded:
ESA's Launcher Challenge award to Isar Aerospace covers 6 missions, not the announced number, people familiar with the deal claim.

Neither ESA nor Isar Aerospace commented.
